svg.title: Trino JDBC Compatibility Boundary
svg.desc: Architecture diagram for exposed-trino showing Exposed-facing APIs, Trino adapters, JDBC compatibility wrapper, and Trino coordinator execution boundary.
svg.text: Exposed keeps its DSL boundary while Trino-specific adapters remove unsupported JDBC, DDL, and transaction assumptions.
Reader contract: exposed-trino adapts Exposed JDBC usage to Trino semantics; it does not add ACID rollback or connector-independent writes.
